answers.agent_surface_today: HydraDG currently implements FCO/FCG (Fractal Custody Objects/Graphs) provenance, multi-agent handoff custody receipts (schemas/agent_model_handoff_receipt.schema.json), deterministic SHA-256 evidence linking, and agent-native execution orchestration profiles (GSD/gsigmad). It features structured turn contracts and single-writer fencing tokens across autonomous agent model transitions.
answers.build_plan: During the hackathon, we will build and extend HydraDG's agent-native builder workflows by deploying an automated FCO/FCG cross-host custody agent node. This node will perform real-time verification of multi-agent handoffs, issue deterministic cryptographic turn receipts over MCP/REST, and provide governed tool access and capability snapshot verification for multi-agent teams.
answers.stack_undecided: Current stack: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), JSON-RPC 2.0, Pydantic, Git/GitHub, ArangoDB/HydraDB, Ed25519. Still evaluating: optimal low-latency SSE event-bus routing for real-time agent-to-agent (A2A) telemetry and zero-trust proxy token rotation under high agent concurrency.
answers.team_status: Solo founder building HydraDG; open to collaborating with builders specializing in frontend UI/dashboards for multi-agent provenance or low-latency agent messaging.
